summary: Build a credible sustainability reporting function with GRI, ISSB, and practical templates. Enroll to improve disclosure quality and control.
lede: Sustainability reporting training covers how to organize ESG disclosures, manage source data, and connect evidence to reporting requirements. It is for professionals responsible for building or improving reporting processes, and develops practical skills in assigning data ownership, assessing material topics, and defining indicators with evidence checks. Participants also practice mapping disclosures to frameworks including GRI, IFRS sustainability disclosures, and TCFD, and preparing reporting calendars and evidence for assurance review.
audienceIntro: This sustainability reporting function training is designed for professionals who need to build, run, or improve ESG disclosure processes inside a live organization. It suits people who work with source data, reporting controls, materiality decisions, and executive-facing sustainability content.
prerequisites: To get the most from this course, you should have working familiarity with corporate reporting, ESG or sustainability concepts, and spreadsheet-based data handling. No programming is required, but you should be comfortable reviewing KPI definitions, source documents, and disclosure drafts. This course is suitable for intermediate to advanced professionals who already contribute to reporting, governance, finance, audit, or sustainability operations.
